query:
INSERT INTO systems
                (address,
                 name,
                 position,
                 body_count,
                 non_body_count,
                 updated_at,
                 updated_by)
            VALUES ($1, UPPER($2), $3::geometry, $4, $5, $6, $7)
            ON CONFLICT (address)
            DO UPDATE SET
                position = COALESCE($3, systems.position),
                body_count = $4,
                non_body_count =
                    COALESCE($5, systems.non_body_count),
                updated_at = $6,
                updated_by = $7
